problem: What is the value of 8x² + 18x + 8xy + 9y + 2y² when 2x + y = 20?

bad.why: Rearrangement and repeated substitution hide avoidable algebra in a long function row.

algebraFirst.description: Isolate y, substitute its expression three times, then evaluate the rewritten function.

explanationNotes: Internally prove target=2(2x+y)^2+9(2x+y)=980 over the full affine constraint. Fit the original relation, then evaluate the unchanged target. A fitted pair or zero residual alone is not a proof. Alternative: c=1; 2x+y=20; 8x^2+18x+8xy+9y+2y^2=c. Adjust c until the original line lies on the target level set. Keep source invariance proof internal.
notes: Explicit user-approved worked example; do not add to the model prompt. 2026-10-27 follow-up explicitly approves the original-constraint level-set slider as a useful alternative. Direct regression is preferred for less adjustment and visual interpretation, not because regression always ranks first. Start the slider away from 980.
